title: formsurface

toolchain.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

build.windows:
call formsurface_oc_install.bat
call formsurface.bat install-desktop
call formsurface.bat desktop build %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%

catalog.name: FormSurface
catalog.summary: Paint textures and materials straight onto 3D models.

notes_for_owner: UNTESTED: formsurface had no build workflow, so no earlier run backs this entry. Since formsurface 0.60.0 ./build_app takes --config and forwards it to tauri build, and Linux builds the deb and the AppImage. Windows (new): formsurface_oc_install.bat installs, formsurface.bat install-desktop prepares the shell and formsurface.bat desktop build forwards %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG% to tauri build; each install step now stops on a failure. The Windows path is untested until its first formcompiler run. Updater: plugins.updater has an endpoint but an empty pubkey, so updater.tauri stays true (formcompiler writes latest.json only when its signing key exists). Catalog: identifier is ai.nodemode.formsurface (tauri.conf.json); products.json says dev.formai.formsurface.
